findings.passage: This bill is common sense, and I’m proud to support it.

findings.passage: In several states, they can obtain a driver’s license and other identification that can be used to register to vote in federal elections. We must protect the integrity of our elections and keep them in the hands of American citizens.
findings.note: Release text issued in his name. Says some states give driver's licenses and other ID that can be used to register, and calls for protecting election integrity and citizen-only elections.

findings.passage: Congressman Jimmy Patronis today applauds the passage of the SAVE America Act, which will add Voter ID requirements for voting in federal elections and proof-of-citizenship requirements for voter registration. Congressman Patronis voted in favor of the SAVE America Act.
findings.note: Release states he voted yes on the SAVE America Act and lists its terms: eligible photo ID before voting, in-person proof of citizenship to register, and removal of non-citizens from voter rolls.

findings.passage: “Proud to join my colleagues to co-sponsor & pass the SAVE Act!” Patronis said on Thursday. “The Act preserves the integrity of our federal elections by ensuring ONLY Americans can vote in American elections.
findings.note: Quoted by Florida's Voice (article dated April 11, 2025; 'Thursday' is April 10, 2025, the day of the House vote on H.R. 22). He says he co-sponsored and voted for the SAVE Act (proof of citizenship to register for federal elections). The cosponsor claim was not confirmed on congress.gov (blocked).
